relations.subject: Wolfgang Schultz
relations.evidence: Schultz studied philosophy and mathematics at the University of Vienna. He also took courses in philology and archaeology. Schultz gained his Ph.D. at Vienna in 1904 with a thesis on Ancient Greece.

relations.subject: Wolfgang Schultz
relations.evidence: Upon the forced retirement of Richard Hönigswald, Schultz was in 1934 appointed Professor and Chair of Philosophy at the Ludwig-Maximilians-Universität München.
